scientific_decision.rationale: The shared request configuration produced 12573 successful boxes before this isolated provider-side URL error. The request produced no box, so retaining the first terminal event and applying the predeclared request-failure fallback avoids selective retry and response cherry-picking.
scientific_decision.immutability_rule: The interrupted source directory remains byte-identical. A separate canonical continuation directory copies every other record byte-for-byte and adds an explicit incident-resolution envelope only to the failed record.
